chunks: And from a letter from him (peace be upon him and his family) to Mu'awiya.

key_terms.إِلَى: To, indicating the recipient of the letter.
key_terms.مُعَاوِيَةَ: Mu'awiya, the Umayyad governor and later Caliph, to whom the letter is addressed.
key_terms.نَهْجُ الْبَلَاغَةِ: Nahj al-Balagha, the collection of sermons, letters, and sayings of Imam Ali.

ai.seo_question: What is the first letter of Imam Ali to Muawiya in Nahj al-Balagha?
ai.summary: This heading introduces the seminal letter from Imam Ali (AS) to Mu'awiya ibn Abi Sufyan, a key figure in the First Fitna, where Ali articulates his theological and political stance against Mu'awiya's claim to the caliphate. The correspondence is historically significant as it outlines the principles of just governance and the legitimacy of the Ahl al-Bayt, serving as a foundational text for Shia political jurisprudence.
